notes.subject: חסידיו
notes.rationale: 'bao ba nago le hesede ya gage' kgahlanong le 'batšepegi ba gage' — ḥesed ke lentšu le tee la Seheberu, le hlokomolwa ka sebopego sa lona.

notes.subject: הדר הוא
notes.rationale: KJV/ASV 'this honor have all his saints' (kahlolo ke tlotla ya batswadi) kgahlanong le JPS 'He is the glory of all His saints' (Elohim ke kgebego ya bona).

notes.subject: הללו יה
notes.rationale: Halelu-Yah — moedi wa pshamele, go swanetšwe go bolokwa bjalo ka Hallelujah goba go phatlalatšwa ka lentšu le tee.

translation: Go dira go bona kahlolo yeo e ngwalwago; se ke bokgebego bakeng sa bao ba nago le hesede yotlhe ya gage. Dumelang Yah!

tokens.gloss: bao ba nago le hesede ya gage
